dct_description_sm: Concerns were raised by Inuvialuit hunters harvesting whales during the winter in the Bering Sea in response to the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear accident. This project aims to determine the radioactive contaminant levels in Beluga. Beluga are an important country food in the Canadian Arctic. The analysis will provide information about whether or not contaminants levels in these resources have changed since the accident relatively to previous levels. It was important to ensure the food safety as well as address the concerns raised by community members. Finally, possible human health impacts of consuming beluga have been assessed.
dct_title_s: Monitoring Radioactivity in Beluga in response to the Fukushima accident (post and pre)
